title: adversarial-verify pattern
acceptance_criteria: Per finding, N skeptics (haiku) each try to REFUTE; default refuted=true when uncertain
Finding killed if ≥ majority refute; survivors returned
goal: Bake the adversarial-verify pattern (docs/05) into the review-board: every finding is challenged by skeptics; only survivors are reported.
notes: Nested `parallel` (skeptics) inside the pipeline verify stage. Implemented in `review-board.mjs`.
